figurative_meaning_en: A woman's in-laws' house or marital home
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিয়ের পর মেয়েরা পরের ঘরে যায়।
পরের ঘরে গিয়ে সে নতুন জীবন শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: After marriage, girls go to their in-laws' house.
She started a new life in her marital home.
note: Reflects traditional Bengali views on women's marriage and relocation to husband's family home
